prompt: Create a high-fidelity static desktop website section mockup for Dapper Detailing Pros Contact Us page, ONLY the Mobile Service Enquiries section. Landscape 1536x1024 edge-to-edge website section, no browser/device frame. Do not repeat its navigation, Porsche, opening headline, map or footer. Reference image 2 is real Dapper work photography: use its actual black GMC Hummer, detailer and setting without fabricating a branded mobile van, staff or different location. This section lets a visitor ask whether service can be arranged at their location. Exact copy: “Can we come to you?”, “Based in Peterborough. Tell us your location, vehicle and the service you have in mind. Our team will confirm whether mobile service can be arranged.” Primary red action “Ask about mobile service”; secondary “Call +1 (705) 977-6217”. Small clear note “Service area and appointment availability are confirmed by the team.” The primary action will return to the EXISTING enquiry form above; do not create another form or automatic postcode checker. No promises of universal coverage, arrival times, free travel, utilities, on-site capability, pricing or availability. No badges, ratings, numbered sections or eyebrow headings. Attractive realistic website composition with readable text. OPTION A: photograph-left editorial split. Left 55 percent is a generous rectangular crop of the real driveway detailing photograph, preserving the person and vehicle. Right 45 percent is calm off-white text with the headline across three considered lines, the last phrase red, short explanatory paragraph, primary red rectangular action, secondary underlined call link and quiet availability note. Use large margins and aligned edges; no floating cards, no decorative overlays. A thin rule above and below establishes a self-contained section. The photograph is the visual proof and the contact controls remain easy to find.
approval: User selected A for Mobile Service Enquiries: photograph left, enquiry copy and actions right. Main action returns to the existing enquiry form with mobile-service context.
